repos_data.description: Tool that allows the AI to control your device in the same way you do, enabling automation for everything!
Always-on context for AI agents: screen capture, OCR, voice, MCP server. Local-first, AGPL-3.0.
An MCP that gives your agent the ability to snap a screenshot of webpages. Useful when you want your agent to check its progress during development.
An MCP server to allow AI agents to interact with PageBolt to take screenshots, grab PDFs, and more.

Windows computer-use MCP server: drive any desktop app via semantic discover-then-act targeting (entities + leases, not pixel coordinates), with per-action perception guards, a native Rust UIA engine, Chrome CDP, and Key Locker credential autofill for ssh/sudo password prompts. Works with Claude, Cursor, and any MCP client.
MCP server for Junipr APIs — screenshots, PDFs, and metadata extraction
MCP server for AI-powered mobile device control — 26 tools for screenshots, UI inspection, touch interaction, and AI visual analysis. Supports Anthropic Claude & Google Gemini.
A native, local macOS toolbox for screenshots, OCR, measuring, keep-awake, pointer tools, shortcuts, windows, workspaces, voice and MCP.
This is MCP server for Claude that gives it terminal control, file system search and diff file editing capabilities
⬆ A simple Mac app designed to make uploading images and screenshots to Imgur quick and effortless.
Official Site-Shot MCP server — let Claude, Cursor, and other AI agents capture website screenshots: full-page, ad & cookie-banner removal, device emulation.

repo_meta_data.description: GNOME desktop automation via MCP — screenshots, window management, and input injection for AI agents
